text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Human experience of overdose with abiraterone acetate is limited. There is no specific antidote. In the event of an overdose, stop abiraterone acetate, undertake general supportive measures, including monitoring for arrhythmias and cardiac failure and assess liver function.
